name: Cristian Salgado

bio.statement: Hillsboro's 2026 candidate packet lists Salgado as the current holder of the Ward 1 Position A seat.
bio.excerpt: Position A December 31, 2026 Four years Cristian Salgado

bio.statement: Salgado's pamphlet statement lists his prior government experience as appointed Hillsboro city councilor.
Salgado's pamphlet statement lists a background in local government, technology and infrastructure, and nonprofit and corporate leadership.

collection_notes: Hillsboro's June 2026 candidate packet (T1) lists the seats up as Ward 1 Position A (Cristian Salgado), Ward 2 Position A (Kipperlyn Sinclair) and Ward 3 Position A (Olivia Alcaire). A June 23, 2026 city news release instead labels the Ward 2 and Ward 3 seats 'Position B'; the county certification and packet say Position A, so this is a city-side labeling inconsistency. Hillsboro news pages for Salgado's appointment returned client errors. Step 5 searches turned up older (2022 or earlier) Pamplin coverage only, not used. City news release (June 23, 2026) says he was appointed in 2025 to Ward 1 Position A; inventory had incumbent=null. Step 4/5 also returned June 2026 KPTV/KGW items on a council censure after a recording incident and 2022 Beaverton race coverage; the censure articles did not clearly name the councilor in result titles and were not fetched or used.
